useCases.title: MQTT Topic Message Rate and Subscription Health
useCases.value: Per-topic message rate and subscriber count indicate whether sensors and downstream consumers are healthy. Sudden drops mean a publisher or subscription failed; spikes can indicate a runaway device o…

useCases.title: OPC-UA Server Connection and Session Count
useCases.value: OPC-UA session count and connection state indicate whether Edge Hub or gateways are successfully bound to PLCs/servers. Lost sessions create data gaps and break real-time monitoring.

useCases.title: Edge Hub MQTT Broker Client Disconnections
useCases.value: Frequent client disconnections or reconnect storms indicate network issues, broker overload, or misconfigured keep-alive. Monitoring supports stability and capacity planning.

useCases.title: OPC-UA Node Value Change Rate and Anomaly
useCases.value: PLC tag value change rate and distribution indicate normal process behavior. Sudden change in rate or value distribution can signal sensor fault, process upset, or cyber event.

useCases.title: Edge Hub to Cloud HEC Forwarding Backlog
useCases.value: When Edge Hub loses connectivity to Splunk, data backs up locally (e.g. 3M sensor points in SQLite). Backlog growth and drain rate indicate risk of data loss and recovery time.

useCases.title: MQTT Retain and Last Will Message Audit
useCases.value: Retained messages and Last Will payloads can contain sensitive state. Auditing who published retain/LWT and when supports change control and security review.

useCases.title: OPC-UA Alarms and Events Queue Depth
useCases.value: OPC-UA alarm/event queues that grow indicate slow consumption or overflow risk. Overflow can drop critical alarms; depth trending supports connector and gateway sizing.

useCases.title: MQTT QoS 0/1/2 Delivery and Drops
useCases.value: QoS 0 messages can be dropped under load; QoS 1/2 add overhead. Tracking delivery by QoS and drop rate supports SLA and broker tuning.

useCases.title: OPC-UA Certificate Expiration and Trust
useCases.value: Expired or untrusted OPC-UA certificates break secure connections and prevent data collection. Proactive monitoring avoids blind spots after certificate rollover failures.

useCases.title: Edge Hub Local Storage and SQLite Backlog
useCases.value: Edge Hub stores backlog in SQLite when disconnected. Disk usage and backlog size must stay within limits (e.g. 3M sensor points) to avoid data loss and device lockup.

useCases.title: MQTT Authentication Failure and ACL Denials
useCases.value: Failed MQTT logins and publish/subscribe denials indicate credential abuse, misconfiguration, or attack. Monitoring supports access control and incident response.

useCases.title: OPC-UA Subscription Latency and Sampling Overrun
useCases.value: High subscription latency or sampling overrun (server missing sample interval) degrades real-time visibility. Tracking supports connector and server tuning.

useCases.title: Edge Hub Container Health (MQTT/OPC-UA Modules)
useCases.value: Edge Hub runs MQTT broker and OPC-UA connector as modules. Container restarts or OOM kills cause data gaps and require investigation.

useCases.title: MQTT TLS Handshake and Cipher Compliance
useCases.value: TLS handshake failures or weak ciphers indicate misconfiguration or downgrade attacks. Monitoring ensures encrypted MQTT and policy compliance.

useCases.title: OPC-UA Write and Permission Denials
useCases.value: Unauthorized write attempts or permission denials can indicate misconfiguration, abuse, or attack. Auditing supports least-privilege and security review.

useCases.title: HiveMQ Cluster Node Health and Split-Brain Detection
useCases.value: MQTT broker cluster faults and split-brain conditions fragment subscriptions and retained state; early detection avoids cross-site messaging black holes.

useCases.title: MQTT Shared Subscription Load Distribution
useCases.value: Shared subscriptions should balance load across consumers; skew indicates stuck consumers or broker-side dispatch issues that inflate latency.

useCases.title: HiveMQ Retained Message Store Growth
useCases.value: Retained messages accumulate with misconfigured publishers; growth risks disk exhaustion and slower broker startup, especially at OT edge with constrained storage.

useCases.title: MQTT Client Disconnect Reason Analysis
useCases.value: Categorized disconnect reasons separate clean shutdowns from timeouts, kicks, and protocol errors — shortening MTTR for unstable OT clients.

useCases.title: HiveMQ Extension Execution Errors
useCases.value: HiveMQ extensions (enterprise integrations, custom interceptors) can fail independently; tracking exceptions prevents silent drops in policy enforcement and data enrichment.

useCases.title: MQTT Topic Tree Depth and Fan-Out Analysis
useCases.value: Deep topic hierarchies and high fan-out increase broker memory and ACL evaluation costs; trending complexity helps right-size clusters and topic design reviews.

useCases.title: HiveMQ License Utilization Trending
useCases.value: Connection growth toward license limits causes hard rejections during peaks; trending utilization supports procurement decisions before production brownouts.

useCases.title: S7comm PLC Read/Write Operation Monitoring
useCases.value: Unexpected write-heavy traffic to Siemens PLCs can indicate tampering or mis-engineered automation; tracking read versus write ratios supports least-privilege engineering and early detection of proce…

useCases.title: S7comm Program Upload/Download Detection
useCases.value: PLC program upload/download changes process logic and safety envelopes; correlating these events with change tickets prevents unauthorized logic swaps that could disrupt operations or bypass interloc…

useCases.title: S7comm CPU State Change Detection
useCases.value: CPU stop/start or mode transitions can halt a line or leave a PLC in an unsafe state; detecting them from the wire supports both troubleshooting and detection of malicious or accidental operational d…

useCases.title: S7comm Unauthorized Function Block Access
useCases.value: Access attempts to protected OB/FB/FC blocks may indicate credential abuse or ladder tampering; monitoring errors and targeted function names supports defense-in-depth around safety-related code.

useCases.title: Modbus Function Code Distribution Audit
useCases.value: Diagnostics and coil forcing are high-impact Modbus operations; a sudden shift in function-code mix can signal scanning, misuse, or a compromised HMI.

useCases.title: Modbus Register Value Change Tracking
useCases.value: Covert changes to holding registers can alter setpoints or interlocks; comparing matched request/response values highlights tampering distinct from normal operator writes.

useCases.title: Modbus Device Identification Enumeration (FC 43 / 0x2B)
useCases.value: Read Device Identification (FC 0x2B) is a common reconnaissance step; bursts from non-inventory hosts often precede targeted attacks or rogue integration attempts.

useCases.title: DNP3 Unsolicited Response Monitoring
useCases.value: Unsolicited responses carry event-driven telemetry; abnormal volume or timing can indicate flooding, misconfiguration, or spoofed outstations affecting SCADA visibility.

useCases.title: DNP3 Control Relay Output Block (CROB) Tracking
useCases.value: CROB select/operate sequences directly actuate breakers and outputs; a full audit trail is required for NERC CIP-style reviews and post-incident forensics.

useCases.title: DNP3 Cold/Warm Restart Detection
useCases.value: Restart commands to outstations reset application context and can interrupt protection; unexpected restarts may follow malware or operator error.

useCases.title: EtherNet/IP CIP Service Request Audit
useCases.value: Unusual CIP services (e.g., configuration writes) against controllers can precede firmware or logic manipulation; service baselines highlight drift from normal automation behavior.

useCases.title: EtherNet/IP Unregistered Session Detection
useCases.value: EtherNet/IP sessions are normally established with explicit registration; traffic that skips expected session setup may indicate tooling errors, bypass attempts, or non-compliant devices on the plant…

useCases.title: EtherNet/IP I/O Implicit Messaging Anomaly
useCases.value: Implicit I/O carries real-time control data; sudden changes in payload size or timing can signal cable issues, configuration drift, or injection attempts affecting deterministic control.

useCases.title: IEC 104 Interrogation Command Monitoring
useCases.value: General interrogation and clock synchronization (types 100 and 103) can be abused for reconnaissance or time skew; auditing masters against expected scan behavior supports grid and plant operational…

useCases.title: IEC 104 Spontaneous Value Change Tracking
useCases.value: Monitoring spontaneous updates helps distinguish normal process swings from stale data or spoofed telemetry that could mask a physical fault.

useCases.title: IEC 104 Clock Synchronization Deviation
useCases.value: Time drift between master and outstation complicates event ordering and SOE correlation; detecting skew supports NERC-style evidence of synchronized operations.

useCases.title: BACnet Object Access Audit
useCases.value: Writes to analog outputs, schedules, or life-safety objects can change building or process environmental limits; auditing ReadProperty/WriteProperty supports both cyber and operational accountability.

useCases.title: BACnet Who-Is Broadcast Storm Detection
useCases.value: Excessive Who-Is/I-Am discovery floods MS/TP-to-IP bridges and can indicate misconfigured devices, loops, or active scanning that degrades BMS responsiveness.

useCases.title: HART-IP Command 48 Additional Status Monitoring
useCases.value: HART command 48 returns extended device status; tracking additional status fields helps catch sensor faults or configuration issues before they affect closed-loop control.

useCases.title: Unknown Protocol on OT VLAN Detection
useCases.value: Non-whitelisted protocols on ICS segments often indicate shadow IT, dual-homed misconfigurations, or tunneling that bypasses zone policies—each can bridge IT threats into OT.

useCases.title: Litmus Edge Gateway Connectivity Health
useCases.value: Gateway offline events stop OT data from reaching Splunk; early detection reduces blind spots in plant visibility.

useCases.title: PLC Tag Data Ingestion Validation
useCases.value: Missing or silent tag streams break dashboards, historians, and ML models; validating expected tags catches connector or network regressions before production impact.

useCases.title: Edge-to-Splunk Data Pipeline Latency
useCases.value: End-to-end latency distinguishes edge capture delays from Splunk indexing backlog; spikes indicate broker saturation, HEC backpressure, or clock skew.

useCases.title: Production Sensor Data Completeness Audit
useCases.value: Stale or missing sensor readings invalidate safety and quality analytics; completeness audits align telemetry coverage with regulatory expectations for critical measurements.

useCases.title: Litmus Edge Device Inventory Drift
useCases.value: Unexpected devices or disappearing assets indicate misconfiguration or unauthorized connectivity; drift detection supports CMDB accuracy and OT security reviews.

useCases.title: Edge Data Transformation Error Rate
useCases.value: Transformation and normalization failures silently drop or corrupt OT fields; tracking error rates ties engineering changes to ingestion health.

useCases.title: Multi-Site Litmus Edge Fleet Health
useCases.value: Aggregating gateway health by site highlights WAN issues, deployment drift, and capacity hotspots across plants without per-host manual checks.

useCases.title: Litmus Edge Connector Authentication Monitoring
useCases.value: HEC token leakage, rotation mistakes, or clock skew cause auth failures that stop ingestion; monitoring auth errors accelerates rotation and prevents silent data gaps.

useCases.title: Centralized Model Retraining for Industrial Sensor ML (DSDL)
useCases.value: Edge-deployed ML models (autoencoder anomaly detection, XGBoost predictive maintenance, CNN visual inspection) degrade over time as equipment ages, processes change, and seasonal conditions shift. Ce…

useCases.title: Device Fleet Online Rate Trending
useCases.value: The share of devices reporting on schedule is a leading indicator of network, power, or gateway issues before production KPIs degrade; trending over 30 days shows whether fixes stick across sites.

useCases.title: Sensor Data Quality Trending
useCases.value: Missing or stale readings break historians, dashboards, and ML features; daily trending exposes ingestion gaps early so teams can fix collectors, radios, or brokers before safety or quality threshold…

useCases.title: OEE Trending
useCases.value: Overall Equipment Effectiveness summarizes availability, performance, and quality; weekly or monthly trends show whether maintenance programs and changeovers are improving plant output without waitin…

useCases.title: Predictive Maintenance Alert Volume Trending
useCases.value: ML-driven anomaly counts should rise when equipment drifts but should fall after maintenance; tracking weekly volume validates model calibration and catches alert fatigue or broken scoring pipelines.
